cards.name: Generic Temporary X Growth
cards.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary X Shrink
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Color Shield
cards.oracle_text: Target creature you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Recipient Shield
cards.oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Target creature gains protection from the color of its controller's choice until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Keyword Choice
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains your choice of deathtouch or lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Crossing Mentor
cards.oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Another target creature you control with power 2 or less gains lifelink until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Legendary Growth
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it's legendary, it also gains trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Regeneration Growth
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. Regenerate it.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Red Bolt
cards.oracle_text: Generic Temporary Red Bolt deals 2 damage to target creature.

cards.name: Generic Temporary Counter Growth
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If it has a counter on it, it also gains flying and lifelink until end of turn.
